# Glaze compatibility boundaries

## Mixing boundary
Never pour G4 remnants into G9, or G9 into G4. They are different fictional binder families and combining them voids both pot identities. A remnant stays in its own identified pot and follows the separate remnant process. The pairing boundary does not describe pot storage or identifier assignment.

## Approved same code pooling
Only pots with the same family code and the same preparation ticket may be pooled. Preserve both originating pot identifiers on the pooled record. No other combination is implied by matching colour names.
